summary.intent: Upgrade GSD tooling from v1.22.4 to v1.26.0, check project progress on CipherBox milestone v1.1, and clean up stale todos that had already been absorbed into roadmap phases.
summary.outcome: GSD v1.26.0 PR merged (240 files, 38k+ insertions). Confirmed CipherBox is at Phase 19/22 with Phase 20 (Vault Migration) next. Cleaned up 3 todos already covered by roadmap phases.

repo: GSD v1.26.0 introduces new agents (gsd-ui-auditor, gsd-ui-checker, gsd-ui-researcher, gsd-user-profiler), new commands (/gsd:autonomous, /gsd:do, /gsd:next, /gsd:note, /gsd:ship, /gsd:stats, /gsd:ui-phase, /gsd:ui-review, /gsd:session-report, /gsd:profile-user), and model-profiles library supporting user profiling pipeline.
GSD local patches are now stored in .claude/gsd-local-patches/ — full workflow/agent/template copies live there as the patch source of truth.
Todos and roadmap phases can drift out of sync; 3 of 11 pending todos were already covered by active milestone phases (Phase 19, 20, 21).

CipherBox milestone v1.1 is Phase 19/22 complete; Phase 20 is Vault Migration (rootFolderKey moves to IPFS vault blob for zero-knowledge architecture), depends on Phase 19 IPNS reliability (already done).
workflow: When running /gsd:check-todos, cross-reference against the active roadmap to identify stale todos that have been promoted to phases — move them to done/ to keep the list actionable.
Pre-commit markdownlint hook will block commits containing new directories unless they are added to .markdownlintignore.

friction: Pre-commit markdownlint hook blocked the GSD update PR — required adding .claude/gsd-local-patches/ to .markdownlintignore before the commit could land.
Todo list had accumulated 3 entries already covered by roadmap phases, requiring manual cross-referencing to identify and clean up.
open_items: 8 remaining pending todos not yet covered by roadmap phases (web worker encryption offload, ERC-1271 contract wallet auth, Tauri auto-update, desktop TEE enrollment, CRDT-based IPNS inbox, async search index, alternative MFA factors, extract core crypto SDK).
Phases 21 (BYO-IPFS Node) and 22 still unplanned for milestone v1.1.
